findings.reason: the node is sized from an assertion rather than from the measured unit rate, which is the exact fit failure §24 recorded and which the plan's own orchestration rule requires be sized from population and rate.
findings.text: §34 says "There is one exclusive all_debug job per storage … run concurrently so both fit one fence" and asks each job for five passes per revision (ten passes), but the only rate it gives is §24's "about 250 to 280 s a pass" in a job that "reached n=2, n=1 and n=1" before its 60-minute fence closed; ten passes at that rate is 2500-2800 s of pass time alone, before the job's corpus copy, and the plan names no fence length and shows no arithmetic, so a worker redispatching the harness that already failed to fit

findings.reason: without a completion floor the done-when's five-pass measure is unenforceable above an honesty clause, and a node can close on the two-pass medians §24 was already reduced to while still claiming to have bought the five the plan closes on.
findings.text: §34's done-when requires "the median of that revision's five passes" yet provides only "An arm that cannot reach five passes says so, and never reports a shorter median as if it were five", with no clause saying what a short arm does to the node's completion; §6's analogous clause states its floor explicitly ("The node is not complete until all three rounds … have run in both arms")
